change: Freeze the complete frame graph once before constructing frame formulas; each formula reuses that same immutable FrozenMap. Existing raw triple iteration and all context contents remain unchanged.

before.failure: All eight full contexts equal source but their object identities differ.

new_regression_checks: Full context equality for all eight formulas, including nested metadata and all triples.
Identity sharing across every frame formula.
Top-level, triple, and nested sequence immutability.
Input-source mutation and detached serialization mutation cannot modify context.
Every emitted formula retains its subject/predicate/object and full serialized frame context.

limitations: Artifact-wide JSON serialization still expands the full context for each frame formula.
Cross-view-link construction and repeated full-context validation are not changed.
Unit qualification demonstrates retained-context sharing, not an end-to-end memory benchmark.
